ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a schematic diagram of the vertical belt spectrum of the south slope and north slope of a certain mountain in China, and the vertical axis indicates altitude; the left side is marked as “south slope,” there is a “lake” near the foot of the slope, the right side is marked as “north slope,” and it shows that the low-altitude zone of the north slope has vegetation belts of arid areas such as grassland and desert grassland. Then reason: this feature of “the south slope being adjacent to a high-altitude lake, and the low-altitude belt spectrum of the north slope being obvious and tending to be arid” can correspond to the Qilian Mountains area. The question asks “how are the illumination conditions in the area north of this mountain”; north of the Qilian Mountains mostly belongs to the arid and semi-arid regions of the northwest inland, with little cloud cover and many sunny days, therefore the illumination conditions are sufficient illumination.
